test: crates/kernel/src/tests.rs: fillet_max_each_reduces_only_where_the_radius_does_not_fit (SolidCraft refuses the fin's round of 4 and its fit reduces it; refs #293)
summary: SolidCraft refuses a round of 4 on the top edge of a 2 mm fin standing on a block (larger than the fin's thickness) and reduces it to the largest that fits. With the cliff overflow (tangency-labs/solidcore#960) solidcore builds it as if the fin's far face were not there and removes only what lies in the fin: the round's corner between x = 19 and 21, along the fin's 30 mm. The pinned SMLib refuses it.

cases.name: fin_top_edge_round_4
cases.note: A 40 x 30 x 20 block with a 2 x 30 x 10 fin on it (x 19..21); the fin's top edge at x = 21 rounded r 4.

removed.formula: 30 * (2*4 - integral_2^4 sqrt(16 - u^2) du) (the round's corner at x 19..21, centre (17, 26))
